summary: ArcBest filed an 8-K announcing a regular quarterly dividend of $0.12 per share, declared by its Board on April 24, 2026, with a record date of May 8, 2026, and payable May 22, 2026. This is a routine capital allocation action, not a special situation. No M&A, activism, restructuring, or strategic review is disclosed. The filing is a standard current report under Item 8.01. There are no deal terms, advisors, or structural mechanics involved. What to watch: none; the dividend is an ordinary course event with no risk-arb angle.
